mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and compresses valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in the last two months signal weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in last 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in the last two months, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market with unemployment below 3.5% and job growth exceeding 100k, wage pressures reduce corporate profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 100k)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting tight labor market conditions, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE has risen for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1600 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has been below 1600 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate exceeding 0.25pp and 0.1pp respectively in the last month signal monetary tightening causing economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25pp and UNRATE increases > 0.1pp in last month
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market deterioration
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25pp and UNRATE increases > 0.1pp in the last month, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of declining industrial production below 100 for two consecutive months, manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate capital expenditure and earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has been below 100 for two consecutive months, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
